source: Website Client Map research (artifact LP2TWYoCY2f8uRS7SiXotq). Prices and ease are estimates; see lead_agent/RESEARCH.md.

approach.sweet: Easy and pays well. Lead with the measurable payback (more project leads / direct bookings). Offer a short example of a similar site and ask for a 10-minute call.
approach.volume: Easy but cheap. Keep it short and fast: a simple one-page site ready within days. Offer the example on WhatsApp; the owner decides on the call.
approach.bigfish: Hard but pays well. Credibility first: send a sample or mockup and proof before asking for anything. Expect 2-3 touches. Reach the owner or partner, not reception. Mention accessibility (IS 5568) only as something worth checking, never as a legal threat.
approach.skip: Cheap and hard. Don't run unless the user picks it.

types.name: Renovation & kitchens
types.why: Jobs worth ₪50,000+, so one extra lead pays for the site. Owner decides. Weak sites are common.
types.look: Premium and solid: full-width project photos, before/after sliders, the real team on site.
types.pitch: A portfolio that sells the next kitchen while you're on site.
types.pitch_he: אתר שמציג את העבודות שלכם ומביא פניות לפרויקטים הבאים, גם כשאתם באמצע עבודה.

types.name: Zimmers & boutique B&Bs
types.why: Every direct booking skips the OTA commission (often around 15%). Owner-run. Payback is easy to show.
types.look: Calm and atmospheric: big landscape photos, room-by-room pages, warm natural tones.
types.pitch: Bookings straight to you, without Booking.com's cut.
types.pitch_he: הזמנות ישירות אליכם, בלי העמלה של אתרי ההזמנות.

types.name: Aesthetic clinics
types.why: High-ticket treatments and marketing-minded owners, but many already have a site, so it's often a redesign pitch.
types.look: Luxurious and clean: white space, nude or gold accents, before/after photos with consent.
types.pitch: Online booking and a look that matches the price of the treatment.
types.pitch_he: קביעת תורים אונליין ואתר שנראה ברמה של הטיפולים שלכם.

types.name: Photographers & event pros
types.why: Visual people who already know they need a portfolio. Freelancers decide fast.
types.look: Minimal frame, the photos are the design. Dark or white, very little text.
types.pitch: A portfolio that books dates while you're shooting.
types.pitch_he: תיק עבודות שסוגר תאריכים בזמן שאתם מצלמים.

types.name: Fitness & yoga studios
types.why: Need a class schedule and sign-ups. Often already on a booking app (Arbox and similar), which lowers the price.
types.look: Energetic (gym) or calm (yoga, pilates): people in motion, a clear class timetable.
types.pitch_he: הרשמה לשיעור ניסיון ישר מגוגל, בלי לרדוף אחרי הודעות.

types.name: Movers
types.why: Every lead is a paid job and they already pay for leads. Very competitive online, though.
types.look: Practical and trustworthy: truck and crew photos, a quote form above the fold.
types.pitch: Quote requests directly to you, without lead-site fees.
types.pitch_he: בקשות להצעת מחיר ישירות אליכם, בלי לשלם לאתרי לידים.

types.name: Trades (electrician, plumber, AC)
types.why: Often no site at all. The owner answers his own phone and decides on the spot. Payback is calls.
types.look: Clean and trustworthy: big call button, the owner's real photo, service area, licence number.
types.pitch: Customers searching 'electrician near me' land on you, not on a directory.
types.pitch_he: מי שמחפש בגוגל בעל מקצוע באזור שלכם יגיע ישר אליכם, ולא לאתר מדריך.

types.name: Therapists, dietitians, coaches
types.why: Solo practitioners who need credibility. They decide alone, but budgets are small.
types.look: Warm and calm: a personal photo, soft colours, the story in their own words.
types.pitch: A page that builds trust before the first call.
types.pitch_he: עמוד שבונה אמון עוד לפני השיחה הראשונה.

types.name: Private kindergartens & daycare
types.why: Registration season creates urgency. Owner decides. Small budgets. (Public kindergartens are excluded.)
types.look: Warm and playful but safe: photos of the space (no children's faces), the daily routine.
types.pitch: Parents find you and register before the year fills up.
types.pitch_he: הורים מוצאים אתכם ונרשמים לפני שהמקומות לשנה הבאה נגמרים.

types.name: Beauty salons, nails, lashes
types.why: Booking by phone is a daily pain they feel. Owner decides fast. The usual objection: 'Instagram is enough'.
types.look: Soft, light, elegant: lots of close-up work photos, a price list, one booking button.
types.pitch: Bookings at night without answering the phone.
types.pitch_he: לקוחות קובעות תור גם בלילה, בלי שתצטרכי לענות לטלפון באמצע טיפול.

types.name: Hair salons & barbershops
types.why: The fastest yes: owner in the chair, booking pain, small decision. Also the smallest budget.
types.look: Bold and dark for barbers (strong type, black and brass); lighter for hair salons. Photos of real cuts.
types.pitch_he: קביעת תור מהטלפון, בלי לחכות ובלי שיחות באמצע תספורת.

types.name: Restaurants & cafés
types.why: Easy to reach and the gap is obvious, but margins are thin and Wolt / 10bis already cover orders.
types.look: Appetite first: big food photography, the menu one tap away, the place's own colours.
types.pitch: Your menu and table booking on Google, without the delivery-app commission on pickups.
types.pitch_he: התפריט והזמנת שולחן ישר מגוגל, והזמנות איסוף בלי עמלה של אפליקציות המשלוחים.

types.name: Real-estate agents
types.why: Listings live on Yad2 and Madlan, so the site has to be a personal brand. Competitive and sceptical.
types.look: Polished personal brand: a professional portrait, current listings, neighbourhood pages.
types.pitch: Sellers pick the agent they found and trusted online.
types.pitch_he: מוכרים בוחרים מתווך שמצאו ברשת וסומכים עליו, לא עוד מודעה ביד2.

types.name: Boutiques & shops
types.why: They want an online store, which is more work (stock, payments, delivery). 'Instagram is enough' is strong here.
types.look: Brand-led: product photography, the shop's own palette, a simple catalogue.
types.pitch: Sell after closing time: a small catalogue with WhatsApp ordering.
types.pitch_he: למכור גם אחרי שעות הסגירה: קטלוג קטן עם הזמנה בוואטסאפ.

types.name: Accountants & bookkeepers
types.why: Conservative, referral-based, busy around reporting deadlines. They pay once they trust you.
types.look: Conservative and clean: navy and white, a clear service list, no stock-photo handshakes.
types.pitch: New clients from Google, and a contact form that sorts enquiries for you.
types.pitch_he: לקוחות חדשים מגוגל, וטופס פנייה שממיין לכם את הפניות.

types.name: Dentists
types.why: High lifetime value per patient, but dental marketing agencies already court them and a receptionist screens calls.
types.look: Clean and calming: white and teal, the real team and clinic, gentle smile photos.
types.pitch: New patients book online, and the site meets the accessibility standard.
types.pitch_he: מטופלים חדשים קובעים תור אונליין, באתר נגיש שעומד בתקן.

types.name: Lawyers
types.why: Highest value per client (highest Google Ads cost per lead), but risk-averse, partners decide, and competition is heavy.
types.look: Serious and typographic: dark navy or charcoal, practice-area pages, credentials up front.
types.pitch: Practice-area pages that bring in the cases you want.
types.pitch_he: עמודי תחומי עיסוק שמביאים את התיקים שאתם רוצים.

types.name: Garages
types.why: Word of mouth fills the bays. Old-school owners rarely see the point, and budgets are small.
types.look: Practical: services and prices, test (טסט) reminders, a map and opening hours.
types.pitch: Test-date reminders and quotes on WhatsApp.
